senses.gloss: or <cite ref="A00510"><he>אֲהֵן</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00489"><he>אֲהוֹן</he></cite> m. (= <cite ref="E00650"><he>הָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00175"><he>הֲהָן</he></cite>, √<he>ה־</he>)

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:11">Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ חזירא</he> that swine. Ib. VI, 10ᵃ bot. <he>א׳ דמר</he> he who says.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:6:2">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כא׳ דתנינן</he> as that (Mishnah) which we have been taught.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:4:6">Y. Shek. II, 47ᵃ</cite> top <he>א׳ דהכא</he> the subject just quoted. Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ (<cite ref="A00489"><he>אהון</he></cite>) <he>אהין להן לי אהן מהו חשוב</he> of what use is this to me? of what value is it to me?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 3:8:7">Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>וא׳ אפילו</he> and this ‘even’—i.e. why do you use the word ‘even’?—a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:23">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל א׳ דאת אזיל</he> wherever thou goest.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:19">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> top <he>אכלון ואהון וכ׳</he> eat ye and then drink.
